<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
